correctness.rationale: For every even alphabet, decompose valid RC orbits according to an allowed first-letter transversal of size a. a²(h-a) middle-unused orbits are independent; each pair of used first letters admits at most one edge orientation with arbitrary nonempty first-letter choices, giving factor (2(1+x²)^a-1). Binomial inversion handles contained-vs-equal first sets and yields the polynomial. Boundary cases, endpoints, self-overlaps, and equality cases are checked; exact independent exhaustive q=2,4,6 codebook enumeration and polynomial expansion through h=9 passed.

value.rationale: The all-cardinality codebook-size distribution is a motivated exact enumeration distinct from extremal code size: it counts nonmaximal constrained synchronizing code designs at every size and yields their entire coefficient spectrum, moments and tail counts. Handling multiple extension choices requires a nontrivial binomial-inversion and directed-orbit decomposition, rather than a known-table recomputation or arbitrary finite slice. Does not claim broader optimal constructions.
